versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the debt-payoff-plan skill.
- Generates a detailed debt payoff schedule using either the avalanche or snowball method.
- Compares both methods by showing interest paid and time to debt freedom.
- Provides a clear, tailored recommendation based on user preference (lowest cost vs. fastest wins).
- Highlights key cautions including minimum payments and plan assumptions.
- Intended for educational planning, not personalized financial advice.
